recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add Group or Location to MeasureReport.reporter for FHIR-14330; any future need for multiple accountable practitioners or grouped reporting should be handled through a new CQI decision or the DEQM follow-up path noted by FHIR-38002.
issue_request: FHIR-14330 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core MeasureReport change request asking to replace reportingOrganization with reporter 0..* Reference(Practitioner | PractitionerRole | Location | Organization | Group) and to note that alignment between reporter and reporting agencies would need arrangement-specific guidance.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN 13290, represented in git by a1cc4ed53f2d5cbc4633b5869d6c58d983fc81ef, which changed MeasureReport.reportingOrganization to MeasureReport.reporter and broadened the target types in the then-authoritative MeasureReport spreadsheet.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines MeasureReport.reporter as Reference(Practitioner | PractitionerRole | Organization) and includes a committee note about the relationship between reporters, reporting vendors, practitioners, providers, and organizations. Later final core decisions explain the differences from the original STU3 request: FHIR-15913 and FHIR-38002 remove Group from reporter because Groups do not act or take responsibility, and FHIR-32985 moves Location support to a separate MeasureReport.location element.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The obsolete reportingOrganization element is absent; MeasureReport.reporter and MeasureReport.location are present in current source; and the remaining mismatch with the original requested type list is intentional current-spec behavior after later Jira decisions.

related_jiras.note: Published core decision removed Group from MeasureReport.reporter because Groups are subjects/collections rather than actors.

Resolved No Change request considered reporter 0..* or Group support and documents later CQI review of reporter cardinality/group use cases.
